puzzleText:
Black hat hackers use a variety of tools to pursue their malicious activities.
Decode each of the software tools below using the following clues to learn about their nefarious ways:

    1. Laptop lumberjack pays attention to each stroke.

    2. Subterranean software stealthily sowing seeds of control.

    3. Digital detective dog with a nose for network mischief.

Can you fill in the blanks to get the correct name for each hacker software tool?
hint:
Fill-in Format:
KEY _ _ _ _ _ _ (6 letters)
ROOT _ _ _ (3 letters)
PACKET _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (7 letters)
title: Hacker's Tool Box
